workload.motionPolicy: Valid stationary actual server-projected arrival coordinates; each frame executes real membership/control/geometry/dirty tick. Staggered deadlines/single-flight normal ACK; no replay bursts. Pause fault continues nominal stationary sends until transport disconnection, counts them separately from readable cadence. No production movement-limit relaxation.
workload.pointerPolicy: At least 50 ms between generator sends, single-flight normal ACK, and at least 50 ms after a normal ACK before the next send. Captured socket/subscription guard prevents stale completion from releasing a new send. The paused-reader fault keeps its nominal 20 Hz send policy. Supplied current subscriptionId, bounded coordinates and one actual selected element ID. Maximum requested 20 Hz; achieved readable 18..20.5 Hz remains required. A fresh connection resets only volatile pending flags/deadlines; held old completions cannot block or release its current send.

measurement.recovery: Final recovery verifies all 202 seed IDs, 20 tombstones, exact untouched and latest payloads, latest 100 retained scheduled chats by receipt sequence and two metadata-only files per house. Immediate slow-recovery grading captures the actual immutable subscribe cursor and snapshot, awaits only HTTP writes already started before its ACK, then grades the per-receipt version journal and latest 100 seed/scheduled chats through that cursor. Future writes cannot invalidate that snapshot, and missing cutoff state cannot pass.

review.confirmedFindings: Original reflection/deadline/protocol defects were reproduced and repaired. Later source controls found a feasible moving snapshot cutoff and compressed normal pointer arrivals after a 93 ms ACK; the specific historical failures remain unattributed. Quota-only matched diagnostics supported removing whole-scene patch churn. Real-service queued ping controls reproduced a false close below unchanged queue bounds. Contextual independent review checked exact quota/control/cutoff sources and actual controls; six stale-completion controls passed. All runtime bounds and full workload gates remain unchanged. Real current-subscription pressure fixture proved a large ACK plus legal transient presence filled the eight-packet queue below four MiB. Presence now coalesces while busy and flushes latest current-authorized state only to that view; reliable ACK/patch/chat packet and byte bounds are unchanged. Matching real house heartbeat controls support the same typed control-packet accounting. Fresh source review accepted authorization/epoch/listener cleanup, with strengthened automatic-drain grading required.
review.execution: Original and quota-only shortened diagnostics, interrupted full candidate and explicit quiet-host retry remain preserved FAIL/DIAGNOSTIC. New candidate fixes confirmed transient presence pressure and current-connection pending state, generalizes only host reporting, and preserves all acceptance gates. Final local native/check gates and one controlled CI runner execution are pending; no local full retry is authorised.
